battery_low.title: {device_name}: battery low
battery_low.description: {resource_name} reports low energy supply. Replace or recharge it soon.

refill_empty.title: {device_name}: refill empty

fill_nearly_full.title: {device_name}: container nearly full
fill_nearly_full.description: {resource_name} reports that the container is nearly full. Empty it soon.

fill_full.title: {device_name}: container full
fill_full.description: {resource_name} reports that the container is full. Empty it.

error_active.title: {device_name}: error active
error_active.description: {resource_name} reports an active error (resource type {resource_type_id}). Check the device for details.

connection_offline.title: {device_name}: offline
connection_offline.description: {resource_name} reports that the device is offline.
